'''Explosive shackles''' were a type device used to intimidate [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] in order to deter escape attempts. Built with small but lethal [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charges]], they were composed of a collar and belt joined by [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] chains. If the wearer left a specific area or moved more than certain distance from the control unit, these devices were set to explode at the push of a button on a [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]].<ref name="LoNH" />
